name: bench-processing
purpose: Benchmark corpus family for higher-active-series or processing-heavy bounded-output workloads where local Prometheus timing bands are useful context.

stackAssumptions.profiledSweep: isolated benchmark stack seeded by scripts/seed-long-range.sh; the profile-50k active-series preset is preferred for processing latency signal

profileCorpora.use: Default profile-50k active-series sweep corpus for processing-heavy instant and range queries.

comparisonNotes: Rows use structural comparison where Prometheus and ClickHouse legitimately differ in exact extrapolated values.
targetPromP50Ms bands are advisory and host-dependent; they help interpret processing-workload size, not correctness.
